purpose: Compact cumulative ledger used to review prior learning before publishing each new immutable daily package.

days.topic: Think in chunks, not translated words
coreMentalModels: Fluent retrieval works better with reusable chunks than word-by-word translation
Build an English sentence spine before adding detail
Grammar choices encode viewpoint, not only time
soundFocus: function words are often reduced in natural speech
pragmaticsDiscourseFocus: short reaction chunks maintain conversational flow
languageSystemFocus: English relies strongly on word order and helper words
collocation as part of language knowledge
days.spokenOutput: 60 seconds about current life using at least four Day 1 chunks

coreMentalModels: A self-introduction is selected information shaped for the audience, not a complete biography
Create conversation hooks through relevant specificity
Build flexible 10-, 30-, and 60-second versions instead of memorizing one script
soundFocus: prominence on information-bearing words inside an introduction
grammarFocus: simple forms for relatively stable identity facts
ongoing frames for the current chapter of life
preview only: present continuous/present-perfect frames will be taught deeply on their roadmap days
pragmaticsDiscourseFocus: accurate identity framing without overclaiming expertise
languageSystemFocus: identity is packaged differently depending on discourse relevance
grammatical framing changes what aspect of identity becomes foregrounded
conversation distributes the floor between speakers
introducedChunks: Outside of work, I'm really into…

coreMentalModels: A routine is a recurring pattern, not a perfect timetable

Describe the normal pattern first and then meaningful exceptions
soundFocus: lighter function words in connected speech
preview of weak forms without forcing accent imitation
reuse of thought groups from Day 2
grammarFocus: Present Simple as a habit/current-pattern viewpoint preview
frequency adverb placement before lexical verbs and after be

routine talk reveals lifestyle and priorities
pattern plus exception creates more conversational detail
languageSystemFocus: ordinary language efficiently represents patterns without exact measurement
habit descriptions also function as identity signals
